verdicts.reason: A rearranges the layout: the turbine and the three-line headline are larger and dominant, but the cluster sits left of centre (about x=320 on a 768 canvas). The decorative green, blue and red shapes now float inside the canvas with flat, cropped edges instead of running off the edges as in the original, so they look like clipped fragments. B is just a shrunken copy of the original pillarboxed in the middle: all the decorations stop at a hard invisible edge near x=125 and x=640, leaving dead side margins. Its headline and turbine are noticeably smaller, so B fails fit-to-format.
